## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `pnpm release:check` passes
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation updated when needed
- [ ] No generated files, credentials, private screenshots, or customer data included
- [ ] Offline core and explicit external-transfer consent boundaries preserved

## Adversarial review

List failure modes, privacy risks, regression risks, and rollback considerations reviewed for this change.
